name: CV-Bench
description:
Cambrian Vision-Centric Benchmark (CV-Bench)
	

This repository contains the Cambrian Vision-Centric Benchmark (CV-Bench), introduced in Cambrian-1: A Fully Open, Vision-Centric Exploration of Multimodal LLMs.

	
		
		Files
	

The test*.parquet files contain the dataset annotations and images pre-loaded for processing with HF Datasets.
These can be loaded in 3 different configurations using… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/mteb/CV-Bench.
evaluation_method: task-specific (accuracy for VQA; CIDEr/BLEU for captioning; retrieval metrics for retrieval)
general_score_metric: task-specific composite (accuracy for VQA; CIDEr/BLEU for captioning; recall@k for retrieval)
reputation: Relatively recent benchmark introduced with Cambrian-1 to evaluate multimodal LLMs; gaining attention in multimodal research communities.
